work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework to power the backend of Turbot Guardrails; secured endpoints with JWT client-token authentication, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was enforced; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures.
Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second and eliminating out-of-memory failures.
Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering compliance audits, improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs, unifying GitHub Actions workflows and shipping HCL function-call support by extending the shared pipe-fittings Go library.
